thread:
emily: Quick heads-up — Prospect (NordBank) wants a strict EU-only POC next week. They said: inference, logs, metrics, and debug dumps must remain in EU. Need a single-sentence summary for the SOW + a short presales checklist we can send.

raj: Short summary for SOW: \"All request payloads, model inputs/outputs, and per-request logs will be stored and processed only within EU regions. Aggregated, non-identifiable operational analytics may be processed outside the EU unless Customer selects Dedicated/Private deployment.\"

nina: Clarifying note: Hosted can enforce regional routing but cannot guarantee zero-control-plane touchpoints outside EU for certain analytics/backfills. Dedicated (EU-only) or Private eliminates that surface.

emily: Can you give plain bullet points I can paste into email for the customer (they're technical but want one doc)?

raj: Paste-ready checklist:
- Choose deployment: Hosted (fast, limited control-plane caveat) or Dedicated (EU-only, VPC/KMS scoping).
- Select egress policy: reject (reject requests if EU capacity unavailable) or nearest (allow non-EU fallback).
- Confirm BYOK/KMS requirement.
- Complete security questionnaire + provide PO contact.
- Approve subprocessor list (link).
- Sign POC scope & ops kickoff (include warmup window and any provisioning fee).

ops-bot: Ticket created INC-11321 for EU Dedicated warmup. Typical warmup 48-72h after approval.

emily: What exact wording should we use for \"no cross-border egress\" vs reality? Customer asked how to phrase it to legal.

infra-eng: Suggested: \"When Dedicated EU-only is selected and egress_policy is set to 'reject', Redwood will process and persist tenant request data only in EU regions. If EU capacity is exhausted, requests will be rejected. Control-plane aggregated analytics may be routed outside the EU for product telemetry unless Dedicated/Private is selected.\"

legal-bot: We can provide SCCs and current subprocessor list for presales. Formal attestation (signed vendor artifacts like SOC/ISO) typically 10-15 business days depending on vendor responsiveness. Add that timeline to the SOW.

emily: Great. Raj, Nina — please paste the checklist + SOW sentence into the email thread to NordBank. I'll attach the subproc link and ping legal for attestation.

nina: Sent the checklist and SOW sentence to the draft email. Included link: https://redwood.example.com/subproc-inventory#eu and asked customer to confirm fallback choice.

raj: Also noted pricing options: Hosted with routing pref (no fee), Short Dedicated trial (1-2 weeks, ops signoff, provisioning fee; possible trial credits), Private/on-prem (multi-week).

emily: Thanks all — tagging @legal-bot for attestation start once NordBank signs the POC scope.

participants: emily, raj, nina, ops-bot, legal-bot, infra-eng
